smoke-fix-r2-2 diagnosis: this is not a fault between items. Nothing from platform-core, v1 or v2 exists in the tree. convo-agent/ holds only v3/ (__init__.py, mock_api.py, data/). There is no convo.sh, no common/, no v1/, no v2/, and git log --all shows no commit that ever touched those paths. The board marks them [done], but their files never landed. A small smoke fix can't help: the launcher, common.conductor, v1 (workflow, smoke, manifest) and v2 (server) all have to be built first.
